objectives.text: Install a JDK 25 LTS build and Apache Maven, then confirm both with java -version and mvn -v
Tell the JDK from a JRE and explain why javac, java and Maven must each be found on the PATH
Open a Maven project in the IDE and select JDK 25 as its project SDK

minutes.basis: Measured in the java-basics module PR on 2026-10-13. modeledP50: p50 of the frozen workflow/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py run on the current artifact.html bytes. modeledWorstPath: modeledP50 plus 2.0 minutes for the worst required route recorded as routes.wrongTwice in qa-paths.json: reading the feedback on a wrong prediction (0.5), one wrong attempt and its feedback in each practice activity (1.0) and the apply retry in its second representation (0.5). aboutLabel and budget = ceil(max(modeledP50, modeledWorstPath)), within the 15 minute ceiling; F4 and F5 topic budgets total well under the 120 minute day. The real-machine install steps in the recap are read on the page and counted; the downloads and installers then run on the learner's own computer, and that time depends on the network and machine, so it is not modeled in this page budget.
